captions.detailed: This 3D model features a compact pedestal-style fixture with three independent rotating branches stacked vertically. It consists of a wide, dark grey cylindrical base, a tall central grey post, and three orange-colored radial arm assemblies. Each arm is mounted to the central post via a small dark grey bracket and terminates in a light grey rectangular block. Each branch is designed to rotate independently around its own vertical axis, forming three revolute joints.
captions.instruction: Generate a compact pedestal fixture with three vertically stacked rotating branches. The base should be a wide, dark grey cylinder with a tall central grey post. Along the post, mount three independent orange arms, each attached via a small dark grey support and ending in a light grey rectangular block, allowing each arm to rotate independently as a revolute joint.
captions.factory: The code constructs a base using a wide, flat cylinder and a taller central cylinder for the post. Each of the three branches is built as a separate part containing a small rectangular mounting bracket, a cylindrical joint hub, an extruded arm, and an end-effector block. These branches are positioned at staggered heights and orientations along the central post and are connected to it using three separate revolute joints.
